evidence.alignment: The selected technologies (dry electrode, anhydrous electrolyte, thermal composites, large-format casting) align well with EV/battery growth markets through 2030, but significant timing errors (mean 1.5 years late) indicate missed market windows, particularly for 건식 전극 필름 제조 which arrives 2.75 years after its boom.
evidence.sequencing: Dependency chains are respected (T08→T01→T02→T03) with zero dependency violations, but 대형 주조 배터리 하우징 has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), which is physically unrealistic for a TRL-6 packaging technology requiring manufacturing scale-up.
evidence.investment: Strategic tier assignment for 건식 전극 필름 제조 and 비상상황 협력 제어 시스템 is justified by high market opportunity and urgency scores, and budget is fully unspent (0/41.7B), suggesting the investment allocation exists only on paper without actual capital deployment planning.
evidence.coherence: Technologies form a coherent EV battery ecosystem narrative: electrolyte → electrode → housing → thermal management, with an autonomous safety layer (T05), representing a logical research-to-deployment progression across materials, process, and architecture categories.
evidence.balance: All five technologies are clustered in Strategic or High tiers with no Exploratory or Low-tier bets, budget spend is 0%, and all completion dates converge at 2030-Q1, creating severe concentration risk with no short-term deliverables or portfolio diversification across time horizons.

strengths: Dependency chain integrity is perfect with zero violations, ensuring technically sound sequencing from foundational materials to integrated systems.
The technology set forms a coherent EV battery platform narrative spanning materials, process, packaging, and thermal management with cross-domain coverage.
weaknesses: Mean timing error of 1.5 years across all technologies means the roadmap systematically misses market boom windows, with 건식 전극 필름 제조 arriving nearly 3 years too late to capture peak opportunity.
Zero budget spend despite a 41.7B allocation and all milestones clustering at 2030-Q1 suggests an unrealistic or incomplete execution plan with no staged capital deployment.
missing_technologies: Solid-state electrolyte interface technology to bridge anhydrous electrolyte (T08) toward next-generation cell chemistry
BMS (Battery Management System) software/AI layer to complement the hardware-heavy portfolio
Fast-charging thermal regulation system as a near-term (2026-2027) deployable technology to create early revenue milestones
investment_issues: Total budget spend of 0 out of 41.7 billion indicates no actual capital has been allocated or phased, rendering the investment strategy purely theoretical.
무수 전해액 조성 (T08) receives Strategic tier despite executability score of 2.0 and high uncertainty (4.0), suggesting overinvestment relative to its execution risk profile.
No Exploratory-tier technology exists in the portfolio, eliminating optionality for breakthrough discoveries that could replace or enhance the current battery chemistry pathway.
timing_issues: 건식 전극 필름 제조 (T01) completes at 2030-Q1 but market boom is 2027-Q2 — a 2.75-year delay that risks ceding first-mover advantage to competitors.
대형 주조 배터리 하우징 (T02) is scheduled with identical start and end dates (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), implying zero development time which is infeasible for a complex manufacturing process.
비상상황 협력 제어 시스템 (T05) at TRL-6 targeting 2028-Q1 completion misses its 2027-Q1 boom by one full year despite being the most execution-ready technology in the portfolio.
